meta.description: Thin-wall phantom-matched GCR response kernel R(E)=D_organ/Phi_ff [Gy*cm^2], per species per organ-shell, at 3 aluminium areal densities. Folded against the true free-field GCR flux and interpolated in areal density to give the direct-transmission-dominated thin-wall effective dose. Valid BELOW the crossover; above it the broad wall-bred secondary shower dominates and the flood MC path takes over. See memory [[variance-reduction-kernel]] / task #17-#18.
meta.quantity: R = D_organ / Phi_ff  (Gy*cm^2); q in D=absorbed, I=ICRP-60 dose-eq
meta.note: NASA/Cucinotta Q twin (N) not present -- thin-wall kernel carries only absorbed (D) and ICRP-60 (I); the thin-wall headline is ICRP-60 effective dose.
